name: deco-whimsical-r2
note: Deco round 2 (owner, 2026-10-23, from the in-game set review): a stack of crates (the single crate was over-corrected to a front view and too big), a cactus in the whimsical palette, and the fountain, the large fountain (2 x 2) and the birdbath redone in the style with scale in mind. Two candidates each.

crate-stack.prompt: CAMERA REFERENCE: the FIRST attached image is a barrel from this game on magenta; draw the crates from the SAME camera as that barrel, seen from the front AND clearly from above, so each crate's lid shows as a real top face (about a third as tall as the front face), not a narrow strip and not a flat top-down view. STYLE REFERENCE: the attached panel is a building from this game, drawn in the game's camera (top-down three-quarter: the object seen from the front and from above at once, verticals straight up) and in its painterly storybook rendering; match that camera and rendering exactly, the same brush texture, the same warm full daylight from high up and a little left, the same soft shadows only in the recesses. SUBJECT: a STACK OF THREE wooden CRATES, two side by side on the ground and one on top of them a little off-centre, rough planks nailed in frames with corner battens, a little crooked and chunky, fairy-tale farm props; the group reads as one prop. The LAST attached image is a layout guide: a pure magenta (#FF00FF) field with a thin grid and a 1 x 1 box outlined in the middle, one board tile. Draw the SUBJECT alone, standing on the ground inside that box and filling it well (it may rise above the box, never past the box's sides), seen in the game's camera, SQUARE-ON (its front face parallel to the bottom edge of the image, never turned at a diagonal), with a soft contact shadow directly under it, and leave every other pixel pure magenta: no grass, no ground, no grid lines over the subject, no vignette. No letters anywhere.
